# No BS Power Wash

## About

> No BS Power Wash & Soft Wash. No Games. Just Clean. Exterior cleaning company serving Bluffton, Hilton Head Island, Beaufort, Okatie, Hardeeville, and Ridgeland SC (South Carolina Lowcountry). Owner: Bob Stella. Phone/text: 843-321-9345. Email: bob@nobspowerwash.com.

## Services
- House Washing (soft-wash process for siding: vinyl, Hardie board, stucco, painted wood, brick)
- Soft Washing (low-pressure chemical cleaning for delicate surfaces)
- Roof Cleaning (kills gloeocapsa magma black streaks without high pressure)
- Concrete & Driveway Cleaning (surface-cleaner pressure washing)
- Pressure & Power Washing (for surfaces that can take it)
- Screened Porch Cleaning (pollen, mildew, gentle rinse)
